OPENAI_API_KEY.prompt: OpenAI API key (used for LLM features and embeddings)

BLUE_DATA_LLM_PROVIDER.prompt: Default LLM provider (anthropic or openai; blank = deterministic-only)

BLUE_DATA_LLM_MODEL.prompt: Default LLM model (blank = provider default: claude-opus-4-8 / gpt-4o)

BLUE_DATA_CLI_LOG_LIMIT.prompt: Max characters shown per truncated log line
